comingLast.roast: done on 20 - somebody propose a toast so he cannot slip out mid-cheer
Smyth is one good hole of his away from inheriting the lead nobody wants
at 1.2 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
in the clubhouse 1 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
safe-ish by 5 - the blue balls have come back from further
done, 5 clear, and suddenly an expert on everyone else's back nine
in the clubhouse 6 above Smyth - cheering for him from a safe distance
in on 6 above the drop - his shout if he survives, tradition says
